q: What would you do if a passenger refuses to follow safety instructions?
a:
If a passenger refuses to follow safety instructions, I would handle the situation calmly and professionally. First of all, I would communicate with the passenger politely and try to understand their concern. I would explain the importance of safety rules for everyone’s safety and share information about the safety procedures.

If the situation escalates, I would remain calm and choose not to engage in any type of argument. Instead, I would inform my supervisor about the current situation and ask for help. It is important to maintain a respectful approach and try to reduce the tension by finding a way to deal with the situation.

During the whole situation, I would make sure everyone feels safe and comfortable. I would stay positive and patient to maintain a peaceful atmosphere.
